newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay to decide privatization of communications.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay to decide privatization of communications.

text.p: The goverment economic issues council of ministers starts today the design of a special law to sell 70 pct of state telecommunications corporation Antelco to private investors, official sources said Reuters.
The initial plan would keep a 20 percent participation for the Paraguayan state and awarding another 10 percent to corporation workers, acording to the sources.
The studies should finish in a term of one week, before beeing sent to Congress, the sources said.
